trunk_backward_isolation.scope: No compilation. All modes use identical BF16 encoder tokens and the same FP32 actor gradient at the trunk output. FP32 control uses those same token values converted to FP32 and dense math SDPA. Reference distributions equal the FP32 actor distributions. Backward is restricted to trunk parameters and tokens.
trunk_backward_isolation.script_source:
"""Isolate trunk arithmetic with identical input tokens and an FP32 actor gradient."""

import dataclasses
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from torch.nn.attention import SDPBackend
from torch.nn.attention import sdpa_kernel
import tyro

from hal.eval.self_play_checkpoint import load_evaluation_checkpoint
from hal.eval.self_play_checkpoint import sha256
from hal.models.replay_actor import ActorTargets
from hal.models.replay_actor import actor_loss
from hal.models.window_replay import ReplaySlots
from hal.models.window_replay import replay_windows
from scripts.o65_replay_probe import compare
from scripts.o65_replay_probe import fp32_copy
from scripts.o65_replay_probe import load_cohort


@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Args:
    inputs: Path
    output: Path
    checkpoint: Path = Path("/o65-results/o64-inputs/step-0098304.pt")
    cohort: int = 0


def main(args: Args) -> None:
    torch.manual_seed(65)
    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
    checkpoint = load_evaluation_checkpoint(args.checkpoint, device=device)
    model = checkpoint.model.eval().requires_grad_(True)
    model.percentile_head.requires_grad_(False)
    model.trunk.resolve_attention("cuda")
    high = fp32_copy(model)
    saved = load_cohort(args.inputs, checkpoint.checkpoint_sha256, args.cohort)
    context = {name: value.to(device) for name, value in saved["context"].items()}
    observed = saved["observed"].to(device)
    slots = ReplaySlots(*(value.to(device) for value in saved["inputs"][5:]))
    with torch.no_grad(), torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16, cache_enabled=False):
        shared_tokens = model.context_tokens(context, observed).detach()
    padding = torch.zeros(len(shared_tokens), dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    high_tokens = shared_tokens.float().clone().requires_grad_(True)
    with sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.MATH):
        high_hidden = high.trunk.forward_dense(high_tokens, padding, force_dense=True)
        replay = replay_windows(high, high_hidden, observed, slots, grad=True)
        targets = ActorTargets(
            saved["behavior"].to(device), saved["advantages"].to(device), saved["selected"].to(device),
            saved["coefficients"].to(device), tuple(value.detach() for value in replay.distributions),
            saved["advantage_mean"].to(device), saved["advantage_sigma"].to(device), saved["denominator"].to(device),
        )
